data.title: Fix random site white/blank: resolve merge conflict markers in random/script.js + reconcile diverged origin

data.body: Production forrestalmasi.com renders blank white wherever the 'random' site shows (0-899px, 1700-4999px under origin's config). Root cause: random/script.js lines 41-51 contain unresolved git merge conflict markers (<<<<<<< HEAD:script.js / ======= / >>>>>>> liquid:random/script.js) — a syntax error, so SITES['random'] never registers and random's JS-painted sections stay empty. Broken since 9039ece, faithfully compiled into every build including production. DECISIONS (from user conversation): (1) resolve the conflict keeping the '>>>>>>> liquid' side — it queries via root per the sub-site authoring contract; delete the HEAD:script.js side (document.querySelectorAll + uppercase strings). (2) local master and origin/master have diverged (origin at fb08a09 has blog commits + a sites.config.json that parks slop/liquid/software/vhs/8bit/memphis/shibuya at 5000-14000px; local has FA-31 branding commit + an UNCOMMITTED sites.config.json mapping all sites at 500-1400). Merge origin/master into local master; resolve sites.config.json in favor of the local working-tree version (user's latest edit, user wants sites visible); index.html conflicts resolved by regenerating with node build.js after merge. (3) User asked 'please fix' the live site — push to origin/master after review passes. Verify: built page shows random text at 850px in headless Chrome before pushing.

Planning note: repo state changed since task creation — conflict markers already removed (f42ddc1) and master==origin/master (acddf87, pushed). But f42ddc1 kept the HEAD side (document.querySelectorAll), inverting the recorded decision: in the built page random's text lands in iphone/liquid/marble sections and random's own sections stay textless. Plan narrows the work to: swap the four init() lines to the liquid-side root.querySelectorAll versions, rebuild, verify headless at 850/1750/950px + DOM check, commit; orchestrator pushes.

Impl done: random/script.js init() now uses root.querySelectorAll with lowercase liquid-side strings; index.html rebuilt via node build.js; committed as 177cbba (not pushed). Verified headless: 850px and 1750px show random with text, 950px shows isomorphic, standalone /random/ renders; dump-dom confirms animated-letter elements only inside #site-random. Screenshots: scratchpad w850.png/w1750.png/w950.png/standalone.png.

REVIEW (commit 177cbba, cold): PASS. Reviewed diff against plan task_01M1MGC6W8DKTKHN2GY69ARQT9. Verified: (1) diff touches exactly random/script.js (4 init lines document.querySelectorAll -> root.querySelectorAll, lowercase liquid-side strings verbatim per plan) + rebuilt index.html; (2) node build.js reproduces committed index.html with zero diff; (3) node --check passes; grep 'document.' in random/script.js = 0 hits; no conflict markers repo-wide; (4) contract: all queries via root, listeners only on root elements, no window/document handlers; (5) random/index.html keeps exactly 5 sections in order, [3] gets 'email me' text + mailto click handler; (6) fresh headless-Chrome screenshots over local server: 850px and 1750px show random with letter text (Forrest Almasi / i'm a developer / what's up? / email me), 950px shows isomorphic unpolluted, standalone /random/ renders identically; (7) DOM dump: all 47 animated-letter elements (exact expected count) live only inside #site-random — the 2 string hits after site-vhs are inline script source, not DOM. Acceptance criteria met. No inline fixes needed. Verdict: done.
